subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with detail-bearing contexts such as cron, heartbeat, and full verbose be hidden from user-visible warning payloads, or should those detail exceptions remain visible?
rationale: Current tests encode visible detail warnings for some exec-like cases, while this PR asserts all exec-like warnings should be suppressed; automation cannot safely choose that product behavior.

options.title: Clarify And Revise Before Merge
options.body: Choose the warning policy first, then update the branch ordering and regression tests to match it.

options.title: Preserve Detail Exceptions
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details visible and narrow the fix to the specific benign warning leak.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Move suppression ahead of mutating handling and intentionally update tests that currently expect visible exec details.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Revise Before Merge
recommendation.body: Choose the warning policy first, then update the branch ordering and regression tests to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this handle to the tool-mutation and agent payload surfaces that need the policy decision.
